rows.statement: Vercel says it protects projects across access, application, and infrastructure security

sides.text: Vercel protects your projects across access, application, and infrastructure security.

rows.statement: Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 is callable through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key

sides.text: Call Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key: no provider account, fallbacks, spend tracking, and traces on every request.

rows.statement: Basic build machines (2 vCPU, 8 GB) available to Pro and Enterprise teams

sides.text: Pro and Enterprise teams can now select Basic build machines, 2 vCPU and 8 GB, a lower-cost option for smaller apps. New projects still default to Elastic.

rows.statement: Vercel Functions are available with Fluid compute and Active CPU pricing

sides.text: Dynamic, scalable functions to power your framework of choice. Now available with Fluid compute with Active CPU pricing.

rows.statement: Notion runs millions of daily agent conversations on Vercel

sides.text: Notion powers millions of agent conversations daily on Vercel.

rows.statement: Preview and production URLs can be restricted via Vercel Authentication, passwords, or trusted IPs

sides.text: Control who can open your preview and production URLs with Vercel Authentication, passwords, or trusted IPs.

rows.statement: Vercel Connect transfers deployment ownership to end users via a claim URL

sides.text: Let your agent deploy apps for users, then transfer ownership with a claim URL so each deployment lands in the user's own Vercel account.

rows.statement: Pro free-domain offer now covers eight TLDs including .app and .dev, free for the first year

sides.text: The free domain with Pro offer now covers .app and .dev, bringing the eligible TLDs to eight. Every Pro team can claim one domain, free for the first year.

rows.statement: The Vercel MCP server lets agents search docs, manage projects/deployments, and query Web Analytics

sides.text: Let your agent search the docs, manage projects and deployments, and query Web Analytics through the Vercel MCP server.

rows.statement: Cursor Cloud Agents can run in Vercel Sandbox on isolated microVMs with scale-to-zero workers

sides.text: Run Cursor Cloud Agents on infrastructure you control with Vercel Sandbox, using scale-to-zero workers, isolated microVMs, and durable orchestration.
